title: Unit 31 Consolidation: Gastronomy, Conviviality & Cultural Rituals

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can confidently apply resultative sublative phrases (-ra/-re) in culinary and transformation contexts
I can formulate nuanced hypothetical sensory comparisons using mintha and conditional verb forms
I can synthesize gastronomic vocabulary to critique dining experiences, textures, and etiquette
